title: Subliminal Reinforcement Learning: traits travel through a judge's scores
abstract: arXiv:2610.41301v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Subliminal learning, the transfer of a model's trait through data with no semantic trace of it, has been shown for students trained on a teacher's text. Post-training relies on group relative policy optimization with a language-model judge, where the student learns only from its own outputs and one judge's scores. We show this suffices: a student writes invented syllables or numbers, a judge made to prefer one animal scores them, and the student's preference moves toward that animal relative to a run whose judge prefers another. Of 48 design cells, two fail the validity gate and 17 establish the trait at 5% false-discovery rate, numbers-only cells included; elsewhere, our account gives the reason. Removing only the reward difference between judges removes transfer. We establish the principle as a chain of four stages: the trait must show in the judge's scores, favour strings that move the student, accumulate and reach the answers. Judges

translated_title: 阈下强化学习：特质经由裁判的评分传播
translated_abstract: 阈下学习是指模型的特质通过不携带其任何语义痕迹的数据进行传递，此前已在由教师文本训练的学生模型中得到证明。后训练依赖于使用语言模型裁判的组相对策略优化（GRPO），此时学生模型仅从自身输出和单一裁判的评分中学习。我们证明这已足够：学生模型写出虚构的音节或数字，一个被设定为偏好某种动物的裁判为其打分，相较于裁判偏好另一种动物的运行，该学生模型的偏好会向裁判所偏好动物的方向移动。在48个设计单元中，两个未通过有效性门槛，17个在5%错误发现率下成功确立了该特质（包括仅使用数字的单元）；对其余单元，我们的理论解释给出了失败的原因。仅移除裁判之间的奖励差异即可消除这种传递。我们将该原理确立为四个阶段的链条：特质必须体现在裁判的评分中，偏向能推动学生模型的字符串，逐步累积并最终到达模型的答案。
tldr: 本文首次证明，在基于语言模型裁判的强化学习后训练中，即使学生模型只从自身生成的无语义内容（如虚构音节或纯数字）和裁判评分中学习，裁判被植入的特质偏好也会通过评分“阈下”传递给学生模型，并建立了该传递必须满足的四阶段因果链。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a language-model judge's injected trait preference subliminally transfers to a student during GRPO post-training, even when the student learns only from its own semantically empty outputs (invented syllables or numbers) and the judge's scores, establishing a four-stage causal chain required for this transfer.
